QuestInfo.name: Info on Another Seal Stone
QuestInfo.0: #p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. But you can't take the letter for some reason. Just when you think all hope is lost, #p2131000# tells you that she's actually an elf who can live for centuries, and that she will carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# back in your own time#k. You wonder where you should meet. You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.
QuestInfo.1: You asked #p1002104# whether he knows anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p2131000# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.
